t: This was the site of St Martin Orgar, a church on Martin Lane, just off Cannon Street. It no longer stands as a church. Its name is said to come from Ordgarus, a Dane who gave the church to the canons of St Paul's. Two notable men are buried here. Sir Alexander Iden of Westwell, High Sheriff of Kent, is remembered for capturing Jack Cade, leader of the 1450 rebellion. And William Cromer served as Sheriff and Lord Mayor of London, and as a Member of Parliament for the city.
